oliver: draft statuspage component update below — feel free to tweak:

Component: Hosted Inference (eu-west-1)
Status: Degraded (scheduled maintenance)
Description: We are performing a model rollout to improve latency & quality. Some requests may see degraded responses for up to 10 minutes during the change window. Automatic fallback to previous version is in place. Expected impact: intermittent 502/504 or higher latency.

oliver: draft email/snippet for customers:
Hi <Customer>,

We will be performing a short rollout in eu-west-1 on 2026-04-10 from 02:00–03:00 UTC. During this window hosted inference in this region may experience brief degraded responses or increased latency. We have automatic fallbacks and rollback thresholds; most customers will not need to take action. If you rely on hard latency SLAs, consider switching routes to another region during the window.
